checks: Exact source and full replacement counts
Final source-line marker after more than 8000 supplied diff rows
Native local edit and undo retain the entire file
Real disk writes refresh the buffer, counters and final marker without reopening
native.scope: Linux source Electron/CodeMirror with real Git and file watches. Functional coverage, not a process-memory or latency benchmark.

benchmark.scope: Five isolated Node parser workloads, three alternating fresh subprocess pairs per workload and phase. Timing/natural GC and allocation sampling run separately; all compared results are exactly equal. Large-diff marker coverage differs and is excluded from the like-for-like performance comparison: largeStats measures only exact full statistics. No Electron process RAM, GPU/model memory, hardware cache misses or end-to-end interaction claims.

limitations: No whole-app RAM, GPU/model or hardware cache-miss measurements
Linux source UI only; no native macOS/Windows UI certification
Large-diff marker behavior differs from old truncation and is excluded from the equal-output performance comparison
The existing supplied-patch and editor size limits are unchanged
